headlines.title: Is T-Mobile US (TMUS) Undervalued As It Expands Its Ad Data Push?
headlines.summary: Vistar Media is rolling out enhanced digital out of home audience segments powered by T-Mobile US (TMUS) first party carrier data, highlighting the telecom group’s growing push into advertising and data driven services. For shareholders, the near term has been choppy. T-Mobile US has a 1-day share price return of 1.04% and a 7-day share price return of 2.80%.

headlines.title: What T-Mobile US (TMUS)'s Satellite Coverage Push and Ad Data Tie-Up Means For Shareholders
headlines.summary: In early October 2026, AT&T, T-Mobile US and Verizon formed a joint venture to expand satellite-supported coverage in underserved U.S. areas, while Vistar Media introduced enhanced digital out-of-home audience segments powered by T-Mobile’s privacy-centric carrier data. Together, these moves highlight how T-Mobile is pairing broader connectivity ambitions with data-driven advertising capabilities that monetize its network and insights beyond traditional wireless service.

headlines.title: T-Mobile reduces a generous discount as customers see prices rise
headlines.summary: T-Mobile is changing a benefit that has helped some customers save on their wireless bills for years.

headlines.summary: Verizon's improving customer trends, broadband growth and AI infrastructure opportunity support gains, but competition and debt remain key risks.

headlines.title: Vistar Media Brings T-Mobile Audiences to Digital Out-of-Home, Exclusively Through Its Demand-Side Platform
headlines.summary: Powered by first-party carrier data, the audience segments give advertisers more precise, privacy-forward audience targeting built specifically for digital out-of-homeNEW YORK, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Vistar Media, the leading global provider of technology solutions for out-of-home (OOH) media and part of T-Mobile Advertising Solutions, today announced the availability of enhanced audience segments for digital out-of-home (DOOH) activation.

description: T-Mobile US, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides wireless communications services in the United States, Puerto Rico, and the United States Virgin Islands. The company offers voice, messaging, and data services to postpaid, prepaid, and wholesale and other services customers. It also provides wireless devices, including smartphones, wearables, tablets, home broadband gateways, headsets, and other mobile communication devices, as well as accessories; financing through equipment installment plans; reinsurance for device insurance policies and extended warranty contracts. The company offers services under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile brands through its owned and operated retail stores, customer care channels, national retailers, and its websites, as well as through T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile apps. It also sells devices to dealers and other third-party distributors for resale through independent third-party retail outlets and various third-party websites. It has 700 MHz wireless spectrum licenses. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. T-Mobile US, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom AG.
